issue_context.title: Matter device - Incorrect multiplier on energy summation
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Per a discussion in the Discord #matter channel, this is an issue directed towards @marcelveldt 

I recently installed a new WiFi connected ThirdReality Smart Plug M1 (model 3RSP03046W).  The pairing process worked as expected. However, when reviewing the power and energy telemetry, the Energy Summation values are off by a multiple of 1,000. The device appears to be transmitting values as Watt-hours (Wh). HA appears to interpret the values as Killowatt-hours (kWh).

![matter ThirdReality M1 Smart Plug incorrect energy summation multiplier in homeassistant 2024-08-15](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/91f51138-ce06-40d6-ac92-5434301901e0)

Other than this decimal point / multiplier problem, my experience pairing and using matter devices with HA has been an awesome experience. Thank you!

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.8.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2024.8.1

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Matter (beta)

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/matter/

### Diagnostics information

[matter-01J5B9KAV293RMMYX0S5N5CG8W-Frith’s Desk-845635c9aa6b6076e86c946f8b7598db.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16629250/matter-01J5B9KAV293RMMYX0S5N5CG8W-Frith.s.Desk-845635c9aa6b6076e86c946f8b7598db.json)
